**FINDING #14 (CP-A2b re-run): defaultFetchIssue calls getVcs() with no args → resolves provider from CONFIG (github), ignoring runtime ctx.provider (gitlab) → GitLab job ran `gh api` on a GitLab issue**

What: CP-A2b MR-B re-run (description corrected) surfaced a config-vs-runtime provider bug. The self-diagnostic message earned itself AGAIN: the log literally said "gh api repos/csrinaldi/brain/issues/1 failed (status null)" — the GitLab job fetched the issue with the GITHUB provider. Root cause: `defaultFetchIssue` (run-check.mjs:169) calls `getVcs()` with NO args → `resolveProviderName` (vcs/cli.mjs:32) resolves `env.VCS_PROVIDER || config.vcs.provider` = github (the fragment sets no VCS_PROVIDER), IGNORING the runtime-detected `ctx.provider` (gitlab, from ci-context detectCi). So #236's direct-API GitLab issueView was READY but NEVER SELECTED — the dispatcher picked github → ran `gh`.

Fix (Part of #231, express): `defaultFetchIssue` selects the provider from `ctx.provider`. Semantics: the referenced issue lives on the platform HOSTING the MR (mirror's #1 is a GitLab issue; same for SCIT). Add an explicit `provider` override to `getVcs`/`resolveProviderName` (precedence: explicit provider > VCS_PROVIDER env > config.vcs.provider), and call `getVcs({ provider: ctx.provider })`. Backward-compatible (the other 5 callers don't pass it). Test: ctx.provider 'gitlab' → loads gitlab, NEVER spawns gh (extend the anti-spawn guard to the DISPATCH level, not just the fetch).

AUDIT (config-vs-runtime class): of 6 getVcs() call sites, ONLY run-check.mjs:169 is a CI-gate path → the only one with this bug. The other 5 (day-start, ticket-start, brain-audit, tracker-board, project-status) are LOCAL commands running in the repo's own config context, where config.vcs.provider IS correct. Fix scoped to defaultFetchIssue.

Live validation from this re-run (all GOOD): node:22 ran in both jobs (#13 confirmed live); MR-B body read via LIVE API with the `Closes` found (loader end-to-end ✓); the fetch-issue fail-closed message named the TOOL and STATUS. The blind-diagnosis cycle is officially dead — the self-diagnostic message pattern has now paid off on THREE consecutive findings (#12 case-A, #14 wrong-provider). Where: brain/scripts/vcs/cli.mjs (getVcs/resolveProviderName), brain/scripts/governance/run-check.mjs (defaultFetchIssue). Related: [[findings/12-gitlab-issueview-glab-ci]], [[pattern/parity-table-before-implementing]].
